difference_from_v2: V2 multiplies quadratic characters of shallow factors. V3 builds one nested field expression by a straight-line program and applies quadratic character only at the endpoint.

search.semantic_domain: the complete nonidentity orbits of all five frozen curves
search.exact_gate: zero endpoint values are undefined and cannot count as matches
search.pruning: deterministic multi-curve beam with field-value semantic deduplication
search.negative_claim: none beyond the explicitly explored beam

promotion_gate: An identical exact expression must pass all five curves before symbolic lifting. A beam miss is not a lower bound.
